household_invitations_open_email_key.name: household_invitations_open_email_key
household_invitations_open_email_key.where: "household_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "household_invitations"."declined_at" is null and "household_invitations"."revoked_at" is null

jobs_attempts.name: jobs_attempts
jobs_attempts.value: "jobs"."attempts" >= 0 and ("jobs"."max_attempts" is null or "jobs"."max_attempts" between 1 and 25)

recurring_rules_days.name: recurring_rules_days
recurring_rules_days.value:
("recurring_rules"."cadence" = 'weekly' and "recurring_rules"."anchor_day" is null and "recurring_rules"."second_day" is null)
       or ("recurring_rules"."cadence" = 'monthly' and "recurring_rules"."anchor_day" between 1 and 31 and "recurring_rules"."second_day" is null)
       or ("recurring_rules"."cadence" = 'twice_monthly' and "recurring_rules"."anchor_day" between 1 and 31 and "recurring_rules"."second_day" between 1 and 31 and "recurring_rules"."anchor_day" < "recurring_rules"."second_day")
